propositions: serverInfo HTTP 200 does not guarantee that GreenHopper custom fields (Epic Link, Epic Name) are registered, creating a timing window where readiness is declared but required fields are absent
wait_for_jira_dc_ready gates on serverInfo only and never polls /rest/api/2/field, leaving the harness vulnerable to flakes that the probe workflow (which polls fields) does not experience
when both tiers gate on different predicates, a timing flake in the slow harness is misattributed to an image degrade instead of being recognized as a readiness ordering issue
the fix consolidates readiness checking into a shared module that polls both serverInfo and field inventory, eliminating drift between the probe and harness workflows
a system-only field inventory (zero customfield_* entries) must be treated as NOT-READY, not as a degraded image, and must fail with the observed inventory dump for diagnosis
